text: The Kerala State Elderly Commission Act, 2025 2025-ലെ കേരള സംസ്ഥാന വയോജന കമ്മീഷന്‍ ആക്റ്റ് Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 20255 Act Number: 5 Enactment Date: 2025-04-25 Act Year: 2025 Short Title: The Kerala State Elderly Commission Act, 2025 Hindi Title: 2025-ലെ കേരള സംസ്ഥാന വയോജന കമ്മീഷന്‍ ആക്റ്റ് Long Title: An Act to constitute an Elderly Commission for giving guidelines in matters related to the welfare and protection of the elderly and to enable their rehabilitation and to undertake and carry out schemes and activities necessary for making use of their skills and experience for utilizing it for the general public and to ensure the protection of rights and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
